claims.text: The latest stable release of Pulumi (pulumi/pulumi) is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (the summary table separately lists v3.261.0 dated 2026-09-02 as of 2026-09-21).
The comparison table lists Pulumi's latest stable release as v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) as of 2026-09-21, which is inconsistent with the v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) listed elsewhere in the same post.
The latest stable release of Terraform is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (the summary table lists v1.16.1 dated 2026-09-02).
The latest stable release of AWS CDK is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (the summary table lists v2.268.0 dated 2026-09-02).
The latest stable release of Azure Bicep is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08 (the summary table still lists v0.46.1 dated 2026-07-30).
The latest stable release of Kubernetes is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable release of Crossplane is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the summary table still lists v2.4.0 dated 2026-08-20).
The latest stable release of OpenTofu is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
The version and release-date figures in the post were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.

By GitHub stars, Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem, and among dedicated IaC tools Terraform is the most-starred, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane (measured 2026-09-21).

Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption, while Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management respectively.
The pricing figures in the post reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
env0 is now named env zero (formerly env0).
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than by seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027 for workloads still migrating.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user, with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials plan starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro plan is $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Enterprise plan is custom, contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then moves to per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
